name: Polyglycerol Esters & PGPR
title: Polyglycerol Esters & PGPR
description: A texture/emulsifier grouping covering polyglycerol esters of fatty acids (E475) and polyglycerol polyricinoleate, PGPR (E476).
what_is: A texture/emulsifier grouping covering polyglycerol esters of fatty acids (E475) and polyglycerol polyricinoleate, PGPR (E476).
why_botia: BOTIA groups these declarations because E475 and E476 share polyglycerol-based naming but are distinct additives. PGPR should not be confused with sucrose esters or with generic mono- and diglycerides.
can_1: Detect E475, E476, polyglycerol esters and PGPR declarations.
can_2: Show the texture and E-number context while preserving the distinction between E475 and E476.
cannot_1: Determine concentration or exact ester composition from the ingredient list.
cannot_2: Treat E475 and E476 as chemically identical.
